model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms across various medical specialties for different fine-tuned models and a base model, Mistralv0.2-Base. The horizontal axis represents six per-specialty terms: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, listed in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and has a linear scale ranging from -27 to -22, with tick labels at intervals of 1. Each group of bars corresponds to a per-specialty term and consists of six bars representing the base model (blue) and five fine-tuned models: Cardio (light beige), Gastro (beige), Infect (light orange), Neuro (dark orange), and Obstetrics and Pediatrics (shades of brown), as indicated by the legend. The bars within each group are arranged in the same order as the legend, with the blue bar (Mistralv0.2-Base) being the leftmost and the brown bar (Pediatrics) being the rightmost. The height of the bars varies across the groups, with the Cardio group having the tallest bars overall, ranging from approximately -26.5 to -22.5, and the Obstetrics group having relatively shorter bars. The bars are not sorted in a specific order within each group, but the groups are ordered alphabetically by per-specialty term. The chart effectively visualizes the negative log probability of per-specialty terms across different models, allowing for a comparison of the performance of each fine-tuned model relative to the base model.
